name: a-extended-const-module-is-refused
note: No `names` on the scenario, and this is the case ABI 4.3's SHOULD exists for: *no* engine names this proposal. wasmtime answers "constant expression required: non-constant operator: i32.add", which describes the instruction and never the feature; wasm3 answers "restricted opcode". A vector asserting a name here would fail every conformant host.
